mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called ―scrap paper‖, often used to produce moulded pulp packaging."
Paper suitable for recycling is called ―scrap paper‖, often used to produce moulded pulp packaging.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means obtaining some economic benefits from materials that has been regarded as waste by someone."
Resource recovery means obtaining some economic benefits from materials that has been regarded as waste by someone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important activity with many benefits."
Waste recycling is an important activity with many benefits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a pressing global health concern."
Antibiotic-resistant bacteria are a pressing global health concern.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reaction between the fuel and oxidant (steam and oxygen) carried out in a restricted supply of oxygen so that complete combustion of the fuel does not take place."
Gasification is a reaction between the fuel and oxidant (steam and oxygen) carried out in a restricted supply of oxygen so that complete combustion of the fuel does not take place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all waste, biological or non-biological, that is discarded and not intended for further use."
Biomedical waste refers to all waste, biological or non-biological, that is discarded and not intended for further use.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to materials generated as a result of patient diagnosis, treatment, or immunisation of human beings or animals."
Biomedical special waste refers to materials generated as a result of patient diagnosis, treatment, or immunisation of human beings or animals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a thermal decomposition of fuel in the absence of air."
Pyrolysis is a thermal decomposition of fuel in the absence of air.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a biomedical waste that has been previously contaminated with any type of pathogen with sufficient virulence capable of infecting a susceptible host thereby resulting in an infectious disease."

Infectious Waste Infectious waste is a biomedical waste that has been previously contaminated with any type of pathogen with sufficient virulence capable of infecting a susceptible host thereby resulting in an infectious disease.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the options for treatment of solid waste."
Composting is one of the options for treatment of solid waste.
